title: RFID attendance system
summary: Best Project Award. Students tap in at the teacher’s desk.
description:
Topicus brought us a real problem: teachers take attendance by hand, and late arrivals make it harder. We gave each student an RFID tag and built a reader for the teacher’s desk: students tap in as they enter, and a web interface records attendance and lets teachers override it manually.

Our team won the Best Project Award.

image.alt: Attendance web interface listing students marked as present
